name: signature
notes: Gold / pink / ink, a poster look. For loud pieces: posters, launches, games. Gold card, ink type; pink is the one hot accent and goes on light grounds only (callout strips, cut lines, hero highlights), gold is the accent on dark grounds. night/night_deep are the hero's two-tone night ground (flat fills, no gradient). Text contrast (WCAG): ink on gold 12.0, secondary on gold 8.0, muted on gold 5.4, on_ink_muted on ink 7.3; pink on gold is 2.2, so never pink text on the card. Display type: Inter Tight is not installed, so Arial Black (the 2080 fallback); mono labels in Consolas. Chart tokens are the default palette, validated on white, NOT on gold: use the default theme for data emails.
